# Hik-Partner Pro (HPP) OpenAPI Reference — Complete Documentation
# Source: Hik-Partner Pro OpenAPI Developer Guide V2.15.500 (2026-09-04)
# Purpose: Full API reference with authentic examples extracted from the official PDF guide.
#          This is the single source of truth for all API endpoints, parameters, and responses.

## CRITICAL RULES

1. **This is the authoritative source.** Every API endpoint, parameter, field, and response
   in this document comes from the official PDF guide. Trust this document over any other
   source. Where the PDF contradicts itself (table vs. example, typos in field names, invalid
   JSON), the conflict is stated in the **Notes** of that endpoint — it is never silently fixed.
2. **DO NOT invent or guess API parameters, fields, or enums.** If a parameter is not
   listed in the Headers/Request Body table, it does not exist for that endpoint. This version
   exposes exactly 63 REST endpoints plus 11 OTAP sub-APIs.
3. **Always authenticate first.** All API calls (except Token) require the header
   `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` (fixed prefix `Bearer ` with a space), obtained from
   `POST https://api.hik-partner.com/api/hpcgw/v1/token/get` with `appKey` / `secretKey`
   = API Key / API Secret (or ARC ID / ARC Key). Do NOT send a `Token:` header.
4. **Token validity is 7 days.** `expireTime` is in milliseconds. On expiry the API returns
   `LAP500004`: request a new token with the API Key.
5. **Base URL pattern:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/...` — `areaDomain` is returned by
   `token/get`; only `token/get` itself uses the first-level domain `https://api.hik-partner.com`.
   See llms.txt for the domain rules.
6. **Webhook and MQ polling are mutually exclusive per account.** Once a Webhook is configured,
   `mq/messages` may stop returning messages; switching requires Hikvision technical support.
7. **ACK every MQ batch** with `POST /api/hpcgw/v1/mq/offset` and the `batchId` returned by
   `mq/messages`; unacknowledged messages are re-sent.
8. **Rate limit:** calls are limited by the platform (`LAP500007`, `EVZ10029`). The PDF gives no
   per-second figure — back off when these codes appear.
9. **All endpoints use HTTPS and JSON** (`Content-Type: application/json`) unless the endpoint
   states otherwise. Success is `errorCode: "0"` (String).
10. **appKey/secretKey must only be used in the local development environment. NEVER commit them to version control, upload to any network, or share with others.** These are sensitive credentials — leakage may lead to unauthorized access to platform resources.

## DOCUMENT STRUCTURE

This document covers 12 API areas with 63 REST endpoints and 11 OTAP sub-APIs (74 in total),
plus typical applications and appendices:

| Chapter | Section | APIs |
|---------|---------|------|
| 1 | 1.1 Common — Token | 1.1 |
| 2 | 2.1–2.4 Site Management (add, delete, edit, search) | 2.1–2.4 |
| 3 | 3.1–3.10 Site Relationship & Handover (share, managers, handover by sharing, end users) | 3.1–3.10 |
| 4 | 4.1–4.5 Team Sites (create, search, edit, handover, delete) | 4.1–4.5 |
| 5 | 5.1–5.11 Device Management (device info 5.1–5.5, device operation 5.6–5.11) | 5.1–5.11 |
| 6 | 6.1–6.6 ARC Service | 6.1–6.6 |
| 7 | 7.1–7.8 Hot Spare | 7.1–7.8 |

| 9 | 9.1 ISAPI Transparent Forwarding; 9.2 OTAP Transparent Forwarding with 11 sub-APIs 9.2.1–9.2.11 | 9.1–9.2.11 |

> Removed APIs (`v1/site/health/report`, `v1/device/iot/ability/query`, `v1/device/iot/add/result`,
> `v1/video/by/time` — removed in V2.15.500; cloud attendance APIs — removed in V2.15.0) are NOT
> documented here and must not be called.

## 1. COMMON — TOKEN

### 1.1 Get Token

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/token/get
```

Get the access token information.
**Request URL:** `https://api.hik-partner.com/api/hpcgw/v1/token/get` (first-level domain, area: General — the only API called on this domain)
**Content-Type: application/json**

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| appKey | Yes | String | Access Key ID (API Key or ARC ID). |
| secretKey | Yes | String | Secret Access Key (API Secret or ARC Key). |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| accessToken | String | Access token, used as the authentication information in the request header (`Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`) when calling the other APIs in this guide. |
| expireTime | Long | Expiration time of the access token, in milliseconds. Valid within 7 days; get it again when it expires. |
| areaDomain | String | The area's domain name. Use the returned domain name when calling the other APIs. Values: Europe `https://ieuapi.hik-partner.com`, Northern America `https://iusapi.hik-partner.com`, South America `https://isaapi.hik-partner.com`, Singapore `https://isgpapi.hik-partner.com`, Russia `https://api.hik-partnerru.com`. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "appKey": "8yedm*****y5z0a7gr3",
  "secretKey": "b2391***54rpcp1k"
}
```

**Response Example (API reference):**

```json
{
  "accessToken": "jmna8qnqg8d3dgnzs87m4v2dme3l",
  "expireTime": 1585747008592,
  "areaDomain": "https://ieuapi.hik-partner.com"
}
```

**Response Example (Getting Started):**

```json
{
  "data": {
    "accessToken": "hpc.6grytwxxxxti2h6kipfb8",
    "expireTime": 1640416102626,
    "areaDomain": "https://apiisa.hik-partner.com"
  },
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

- `accessToken` goes in the `Authorization` header of all subsequent calls with the fixed prefix `Bearer ` (with a space): `Authorization: Bearer hpc.6grytwxxxxti2h6kipfb8`
- Token valid 7 days, accurate to milliseconds; on expiry `LAP500004` is returned
- `areaDomain` is the second-level domain and the base URL for all subsequent API calls. Use the domain returned in the token response, NOT a hardcoded domain and NOT `api.hik-partner.com`. Example: `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/search`

**Notes:**
- The API-reference example shows the fields at the root level, while Getting Started (and every other API) uses `{ "errorCode", "message", "data" }`. Parse both shapes defensively.
- The PDF example keys `"accessToken "` and `"expireTime "` carry a trailing space (typo); shown corrected here.
- The Getting Started example returns `https://apiisa.hik-partner.com`, while the table lists `https://isaapi.hik-partner.com` for South America. Always use the returned value.
- Legacy domains `https://api.hik-proconnect.com` (rest of the world) and `https://api.hik-proconnectru.com` (Russia) were usable until the end of 2023.
- The Getting Started curl example in the PDF prints `Bearerhpc.6grytw...` without the space — a typo; the guide itself states the prefix is `"Bearer "` with a space.
- Auth-related error codes: `LAP300001` (AK not found), `LAP300002` (AK and SK do not match), `LAP300003` (HPP account bound to the AK does not exist), `LAP500002` (access token empty), `LAP500003` (invalid token format), `LAP500004` (token expired or incorrect), `LAP500005` (token verification failed), `LAP500007` (call count exceeds the limit), `EVZ10029` (API call frequency exceeded the limit).

## 2. SITE MANAGEMENT

### 2.1 Add Site

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/add
```

Add site information.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/add`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| name | Yes | String | Site name. Up to 128 characters. |
| timeZone | Yes | Integer | Time zone. See A.3 Time Zone List. |
| timeSync | No | Boolean | Whether to synchronize the time zone. Default: `false`. |
| siteState | No | String | State where the site is located. Up to 128 characters. |
| siteCity | No | String | City where the site is located. Up to 128 characters. |
| siteStreet | No | String | Street where the site is located. Up to 128 characters. |
| location | No | String | Detailed address of the site. Up to 128 characters. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "name": "",
  "siteCity": "",
  "siteState": "",
  "siteStreet": "",
  "location": "",
  "timeSync": true,
  "timeZone": 222
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

### 2.2 Delete Site

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/{id}/delete
```

Delete site information. **Deleting a site also deletes all devices on it.**
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/{id}/delete`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Path Parameters:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| id | Yes | String | Site (system) ID. |

**Request Body:** none.

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

### 2.3 Edit Site

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/{id}/update
```

Edit site information.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/{id}/update`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Path Parameters:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| id | Yes | String | Site (system) ID. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| name | Yes | String | Site name. Up to 128 characters. |
| siteState | No | String | State where the site is located. Up to 128 characters. |
| siteCity | No | String | City where the site is located. Up to 128 characters. |
| siteStreet | No | String | Street where the site is located. Up to 128 characters. |
| location | No | String | Detailed address of the site. Up to 128 characters. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "name": "Apartment",
  "siteCity": "Singapore",
  "siteState": "",
  "siteStreet": "",
  "location": ""
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Unlike `site/add`, this API does not accept `timeZone` or `timeSync`.

### 2.4 Search Sites

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/search
```

Search site information.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/search`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| page | No | Integer | Current page number. Default: the first page. |
| pageSize | No | Integer | Items per page. Default: 20. |
| search | No | String | Search condition: site name, address, installer, etc. Fuzzy search supported. |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| data | Object | Response data (`page`, `pageSize`, `rows`, `total`, `totalPage`). |
| data.rows[].id | String | Site ID. |
| data.rows[].siteName | String | Site name. |
| data.rows[].timeZone | String | Time zone. See A.3 Time Zone List. |
| data.rows[].timeSync | Boolean | Whether to synchronize the time zone. Default: `false`. |
| data.rows[].installerId | String | Installer ID. If there are several installers, the first one is returned. |
| data.rows[].installerFirstName | String | Installer first name. |
| data.rows[].installerLastName | String | Installer last name. |
| data.rows[].siteState | String | State where the site is located. |
| data.rows[].siteCity | String | City where the site is located. |
| data.rows[].siteStreet | String | Street where the site is located. |
| data.rows[].location | String | Detailed address of the site. |
| data.rows[].siteDeliveryStatus | Integer | `0`: site not handed over; `1`: handover in progress; `2`: handover completed. |
| data.rows[].cloudEnable | Boolean | `true` if at least one device has the permission enabled; `false` only if all devices have it disabled (see 5.6). |
| data.rows[].sharedInfo | Object | Site sharing information. |
| data.rows[].sharedInfo.shareType | Integer | `0`: site belongs to the current company and is not shared. `1`: belongs to the current company and is shared with a maintenance partner. `2`: shared with you by another company and you provide maintenance. `3`: belongs to the current company and is shared with installers for device installation and configuration (revoked automatically when the site is handed over to the customer). `4`: shared with you by another company and you provide device installation and configuration. |
| data.rows[].sharedInfo.shareState | Integer | `0`: waiting for end user authentication. `1`: waiting for the other company to accept. `2`: currently shared. `3`: end user rejected the request. `4`: the other company rejected the request. |
| data.rows[].sharedInfo.shareToCompany | Object | Returned when you share your sites with other companies. Only this node or `shareFromCompany` can exist, not both. |
| data.rows[].sharedInfo.shareFromCompany | Object | Returned when another company shares the site with you. Only this node or `shareToCompany` can exist, not both. |
| …shareToCompany/shareFromCompany.address | String | Address of the sharing/receiving company. |
| …shareToCompany/shareFromCompany.companyName | String | Name of the sharing/receiving company. |
| …shareToCompany/shareFromCompany.email | String | Email. |
| …shareToCompany/shareFromCompany.firstName | String | Person's first name. |
| …shareToCompany/shareFromCompany.lastName | String | Person's last name. |
| …shareToCompany/shareFromCompany.phone | String | Company phone. |
| …shareToCompany/shareFromCompany.street | String | Street where the company is located. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "page": 0,
  "pageSize": 0,
  "search": ""
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "data": {
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "rows": [
      {
        "id": "",
        "installerFirstName": "",
        "installerId": "",
        "installerLastName": "",
        "location": "",
        "siteCity": "",
        "siteName": "",
        "siteState": "",
        "siteStreet": "",
        "timeSync": true,
        "timeZone": "182",
        "siteDeliveryStatus": 2,
        "cloudEnable": true,
        "sharedInfo": {
          "shareState": 4,
          "shareType": 3,
          "shareToCompany": {
            "address": "",
            "companyName": "",
            "email": "",
            "firstName": "",
            "lastName": "",
            "phone": "",
            "street": ""
          }
        }
      },
      {
        "id": "",
        "installerFirstName": "",
        "installerId": "",
        "installerLastName": "",
        "location": "",
        "siteCity": "",
        "siteName": "",
        "siteState": "",
        "siteStreet": "",
        "timeSync": true,
        "timeZone": "182",
        "siteDeliveryStatus": 2,
        "cloudEnable": true,
        "sharedInfo": {
          "shareState": 4,
          "shareType": 4,
          "shareFromCompany": {
            "address": "",
            "companyName": "",
            "email": "",
            "firstName": "",
            "lastName": "",
            "phone": "",
            "street": ""
          }
        }
      }
    ],
    "total": 0,
    "totalPage": 0
  },
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The PDF response table lists the site fields directly under `data`, but the example nests them in `data.rows[]` together with `page`, `pageSize`, `total` and `totalPage`. The example structure is documented here.
- `timeZone` is sent as Integer in `site/add`, but `site/search` returns it as String (`"182"`).

## 3. SITE RELATIONSHIP & HANDOVER

### 3.1 Share Site

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/share
```

Share a site. There are two site-sharing scenarios and this API applies only to the first:
(1) the site has not been handed over and is shared with an installation service provider to get device installation services; (2) the end user authorizes installers to manage the site and it is shared with a maintenance partner to serve the end user jointly. Only sites that have not been transferred can be shared.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/share`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| email | Yes | String | Email of the employee of the company the site is shared with. That company must have the site-sharing function enabled. |
| siteId | Yes | String | ID of the site to share. |
| applyTimeType | No | Integer | Site authorization duration: `-1` or empty: permanent; `0`: 1 hour; `1`: 2 hours; `2`: 4 hours; `3`: 8 hours; `4`: 24 hours. |
| describe | No | String | Additional information displayed to the employees. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "email": "xxx@example.com",
  "describe": "additional information",
  "siteId": "xxxxx",
  "applyTimeType": 0
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The PDF example key `"applyTimeType "` has a trailing space (typo); shown corrected here.

### 3.2 Cancel Site Sharing

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/share/cancel/{id}
```

Cancel sharing a site.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/share/cancel/{id}`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Path Parameters:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| id | Yes | String | Site (system) ID. |

**Request Body:** none.

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

### 3.3 Assign Site Managers

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v2/site/assign
```

Assign one or more site managers. When new managers are assigned, the previous managers are removed — except managers with the Manage All Sites permission.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v2/site/assign`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| siteIds | Yes | Array | List of site IDs to which the manager is assigned. |
| installerPermissionTimes | Yes | Object[] | ID of the employee to assign and validity of the site management permission. Up to 100 pairs of these two nodes. |
| installerPermissionTimes[].expiredDurationTime | Yes | Long | Validity of the site management permission (unit: ms): `-1` (permanent). |
| installerPermissionTimes[].installerId | Yes | String | ID of the employee to assign. 1 to 48 characters; cannot be empty. Get it with `POST /api/hpcgw/v1/installers/search` (12.4). The employee must have the site management permission. To remove an employee from the site manager list, assign the site to the company admin. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "siteIds": [
    "aaaa",
    "bbbb"
  ],
  "installerPermissionTimes": [
    {
      "installerId": "xxxx",
      "expiredDurationTime": -1
    }
  ]
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

### 3.4 Get Site Managers

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/sitemanagers
```

Get the list of site managers.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/sitemanagers`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| siteId | Yes | String | Site ID. |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| data | Object | Response data. |
| data.installerMangers | Object[] | Site manager information. |
| data.installerMangers[].installerId | String | Site manager ID. |
| data.installerMangers[].installerFirstName | String | Site manager first name. |
| data.installerMangers[].installerLastName | String | Site manager last name. |
| data.installerMangers[].installerEmail | String | Site manager email. |
| data.installerMangers[].installerPhone | String | Site manager phone. |
| data.installerMangers[].expireDurationTime | Long | Expiration time of the site manager permission, accurate to milliseconds: `-1` (permanent). |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "siteId": "aaaaa"
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "data": {
    "installerMangers": [
      {
        "installerId": "aaa",
        "installerFirstName": "aa",
        "installerLastName": "bb",
        "installerEmail": "aa@outlook.net",
        "installerPhone": "6523123",
        "expireDurationTime": "1873727183782"
      }
    ]
  },
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The field name `installerMangers` (missing "a") is literal in the PDF, in both table and example; keep it as is.
- The table declares `expireDurationTime` as Long, but the example returns a String (`"1873727183782"`).
- In the `v2/site/assign` request the equivalent field is `expiredDurationTime` (with "d"); this response uses `expireDurationTime`.

### 3.5 Hand Over Sites by Sharing

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v2/site/handover/share
```

Hand over sites by sharing. After device installation and configuration are completed, you can hand over devices to your customer (end user) by sharing. After the customer accepts: you still own the devices and the customer only has permission to use them; you can set the device permissions shared with the customer. For sites already handed over by sharing, call this API again to share them with more users.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v2/site/handover/share`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| siteId | Yes | String | Site ID. |
| batchHcAccount | Yes | Object[] | End users' account information. |
| batchHcAccount[].hcAccount | Yes | String | End user's account. |
| batchHcAccount[].type | Yes | Integer | Account type: `0`-email, `1`-phone No. |
| userSharePermission | Yes | Object[] | Device permission details shared with end users. |
| userSharePermission[].deviceSerial | Yes | String | Device serial No. 1 to 9 characters. |
| userSharePermission[].ax2PermissionDetails | No | Object | Security control panel permission information shared with users; valid for AX PRO series security control panels. |
| userSharePermission[].ax2PermissionDetails.ax2Permission | No | Array | Security control panel permissions shared with users. Device sharing: `20`-device sharing permission. Operation permissions (AX PRO V1.2.7 and above): `0`-arm, `1`-disarm / silence alarm, `6`-view logs/status, `7`-zone bypass, `8`-automation control. Notification permissions (AX PRO V1.2.9 and above): `10`-PircamGif, `11`-VideoClips, `12`-keypad/keyfob/app panic alarm, `13`-keypad/keyfob medical alarm, `14`-keypad fire alarm, `15`-smart alarm event, `16`-panel lid opened, `17`-peripherals lid opened, `18`-zone alarm, `19`-panel operation, `21`-panel status (power and battery), `22`-panel status (communications), `23`-zone status, `24`-peripheral status. |
| userSharePermission[].ax2PermissionDetails.areaPermission | No | Array | Security control panel partition (area) permissions shared with users (AX PRO V1.2.9 and above). List of partition (area) No.s to share the corresponding permissions: `-1` (all). |
| userSharePermission[].otherPermissionDetails | No | Object[] | Other device permission information that can be shared with users; valid for non-AX PRO devices. |
| userSharePermission[].otherPermissionDetails[].permission | No | Integer | Shareable permission: `0`-live view, `1`-playback, `2`-two-way audio, `3`-alarm, `4`-call / open door, `5`-PTZ, `6`-sharing permission (not supported by channel-level permissions). By device type: encoding device channel — live view, playback, two-way audio, alarm, PTZ; access control device channel — live view, playback, two-way audio, alarm, call / open door; video intercom device channel — live view, playback, two-way audio, alarm, call / open door; doorbell channel — live view, playback, two-way audio, alarm, call; Hik-ProConnect Box channel — live view, playback, alarm, PTZ; radar device — alarm; switch and router — no permission can be shared. |
| userSharePermission[].otherPermissionDetails[].channelNo | No | Array | Channel No. list shared with the user: `-1` (all channels). Only valid for channel-level permissions. |
| remark | No | String | Remarks. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "siteId": "aaaaa",
  "batchHcAccount": [
    {
      "hcAccount": "ccccc@example.com",
      "type": 0
    }
  ],
  "userSharePermission": [
    {
      "deviceSerial": "ABC",
      "otherPermissionDetails": [
        {
          "permission": 1,
          "channelNo": ["1", "2"]
        },
        {
          "permission": 3,
          "channelNo": ["-1"]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "deviceSerial": "DEF",
      "ax2PermissionDetails": {
        "ax2Permission": [1, 2],
        "areaPermission": ["-1"]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The PDF table spells the field `hcAcccount` (three "c"), but the example uses `hcAccount`, as do the other APIs of this group. `hcAccount` is documented here.
- The example uses value `2` in `ax2Permission`, which is not in the table's value list.
- `channelNo` and `areaPermission` are sent as arrays of Strings (`["-1"]`), even though they represent numbers.

### 3.6 Search End Users of Handover by Sharing

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v2/site/customer/list
```

Search the list of end users of a handover by sharing.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v2/site/customer/list`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| siteId | Yes | String | Site ID. |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| data | Object | Response data. |
| data.customers[] | Object[] | End user information. |
| data.customers[].hcAccount | String | End user's account (the PDF table says "Site manager ID"; see Notes). |
| data.customers[].type | Integer | Account type: `0`-email, `1`-phone No. |
| data.customers[].status | String | Sharing status: `"0"`-rejected, `"1"`-approved, `"2"`-pending, `"3"`-expired, `"4"`-not registered. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "siteId": "aaaaa"
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "data": {
    "customers": [
      {
        "hcAccount": "abc@example.com",
        "type": 0,
        "status": "0"
      }
    ]
  },
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The table declares `customers` as Object, but the example returns an array; documented here as `data.customers[]`.
- The table describes `hcAccount` as "Site manager ID", but the example and the API context show it is the end user's account (email or phone).

### 3.7 Get End User Details of Handover by Sharing

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/customer/detail
```

Get the information of an end user of a handover by sharing.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/customer/detail`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| siteId | Yes | String | Site ID. |
| hcAccount | Yes | String | End user's account. |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| data | Object | Response data. |
| data.shareDevices | Object[] | Shared device information. |
| data.shareDevices[].deviceSerial | String | Device serial No. |
| data.shareDevices[].ax2PermissionDetails | Object | Security control panel permission information shared with users; valid for AX PRO series security control panels. |
| data.shareDevices[].ax2PermissionDetails.ax2Permission | Array | Security control panel permissions shared with the user. Values as in 3.5. |
| data.shareDevices[].ax2PermissionDetails.areaPermission | Array | Partition (area) permissions shared with the user (AX PRO V1.2.9 and above): `-1` (all). |
| data.shareDevices[].otherPermissionDetails | Object[] | Other device permission information shared with the user; valid for non-AX PRO devices. |
| data.shareDevices[].otherPermissionDetails[].permission | Integer | Shared permission. Values as in 3.5. |
| data.shareDevices[].otherPermissionDetails[].channelNo | Array | Channel No. list shared with the user: `-1` (all channels). Only valid for channel-level permissions. |

**Request Example:**

```json
  "hcAccount": "abc@example.com"
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "data": {
    "shareDevices": [
      {
        "deviceSerial": "ABC",
        "otherPermissionDetails": [
          {
            "permission": 1,
            "channelNo": ["1", "2"]
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "deviceSerial": "DEF",
        "ax2PermissionDetails": {
          "ax2Permission": [1, 2],
          "areaPermission": ["1", "2"]
        }
      }
    ]
  },
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

### 3.8 Edit End User Account

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/customer/account/update
```

Edit the end user's account information.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/customer/account/update`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| siteId | Yes | String | Site ID. |
| oldShareHc | Yes | Object | Account information before editing. |
| oldShareHc.hcAccount | Yes | String | Account. |
| oldShareHc.type | Yes | Integer | Account type: `0`-email, `1`-phone No. |
| newShareHc | Yes | Object | Account information after editing. |
| newShareHc.hcAccount | Yes | String | Account. |
| newShareHc.type | Yes | Integer | Account type: `0`-email, `1`-phone No. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "siteId": "aaaaa",
  "oldShareHc": {
    "hcAccount": "abc@example.com",
    "type": 0
  },
  "newShareHc": {
    "hcAccount": "def@example.com",
    "type": 0
  }
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The PDF table spells the field `hcAcccount` (three "c"); the example uses `hcAccount`, which is documented here.

### 3.9 Edit End User Device Permissions

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/customer/devices/update
```

Edit an end user's device permission information.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/customer/devices/update`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| siteId | Yes | Array (see Notes; String in example) | Site ID. |
| sharedHc | Yes | Object | Information of the user whose permissions are edited. |
| sharedHc.hcAccount | Yes | Long (see Notes; String in example) | Account. |
| sharedHc.type | Yes | String (see Notes; Integer in example) | Account type: `0`-email, `1`-phone No. |
| sharedHc.shareDevices | Yes | Object (array in example) | Shared device information. |
| sharedHc.shareDevices[].deviceSerial | Yes | String | Device serial No. Cannot be empty; 1 to 9 characters. |
| sharedHc.shareDevices[].ax2PermissionDetails | No | Object | Security control panel permission information shared with users; valid for AX PRO series. |
| sharedHc.shareDevices[].ax2PermissionDetails.ax2Permission | No | Array | Security control panel permissions shared with users. Values as in 3.5. |
| sharedHc.shareDevices[].ax2PermissionDetails.areaPermission | No | Array | Partition (area) permissions shared with the user (AX PRO V1.2.9 and above): `-1` (all). |
| sharedHc.shareDevices[].otherPermissionDetails | No | Object (array in example) | Other device permission information shareable with users; valid for non-AX PRO devices. |
| sharedHc.shareDevices[].otherPermissionDetails[].permission | No | Integer | Shareable permission. Values as in 3.5. |
| sharedHc.shareDevices[].otherPermissionDetails[].channelNo | No | Array | Channel No. list shared with the user: `-1` (all channels). Only valid for channel-level permissions. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "siteId": "aaaaa",
  "sharedHc": {
    "hcAccount": "ccccc@yopamail.com",
    "type": 0,
    "shareDevices": [
      {
        "deviceSerial": "ABC",
        "otherPermissionDetails": [
          {
            "permission": 1,
            "channelNo": ["1", "2"]
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "deviceSerial": "DEF",
        "ax2PermissionDetails": {
          "ax2Permission": [1, 2],
          "areaPermission": ["1", "2"]
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The PDF table is inconsistent with its example; follow the example:
  - `siteId` is declared Array, but the example sends a String (`"aaaaa"`), as in every other API.
  - `hcAccount` is declared Long and `type` String, but the example sends `hcAccount` as String (email) and `type` as Integer (`0`), as in `site/customer/account/update`.
  - `shareDevices` and `otherPermissionDetails` are declared Object, but the example sends arrays.
  - The table spells `hcAcccount` (three "c"); the example uses `hcAccount`, documented here.
- The PDF example is invalid JSON: it closes the `shareDevices` array with `}]` (one brace too many). Minimally fixed here by closing it with `]`.

### 3.10 Cancel Sharing with End Users

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/customer/cancle
```

Cancel sharing with end users.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/customer/cancle`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| siteId | Yes | String | Site ID. |
| hcAccounts | Yes | Array | List of user accounts. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "siteId": "aaaaa",
  "hcAccounts": [
    "aaa",
    "bbb"
  ]
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The path `cancle` is a literal typo of the API and must be used as is (`cancel` does not exist).
- The PDF table spells the field `hcAcccounts` (three "c"); the example uses `hcAccounts`, documented here.

---

## 4. TEAM SITES

> Team sites use `systemName`, `timezone` and `syncTimezone` (Integer) instead of the
> `name`, `timeZone` and `timeSync` (Boolean) of chapter 2.

### 4.1 Create Team Site

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/team/add
```

Create a team site. If `serverType` is not configured, no services are activated and devices cannot be added.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/team/add`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| systemName | Yes | String | Site (system) name. 1 to 128 characters. Cannot contain special characters such as `: * ? " < > \|`. |
| timezone | Yes | Integer | Time zone. See A.3 Time Zone List. |
| syncTimezone | No | Integer | Whether to synchronize the site time zone to the devices on the site: `1` (enable), `0` or other values (disable). If absent, disabled by default. |
| serverType | No | Array | Services to activate: `0` (video management service), `1` (vehicle service), `2` (alarm detection service), `[3, 6]` (access control and attendance service), `4` (video intercom service), `5` (analysis report service; requires the video management service, otherwise unavailable), `9` (ANPR service), `10` (health detection service), `11` (IP speaker service). |
| systemScene | No | Integer | Scene type: `0` (residential), `1` (apartment), `2` (villa), `3` (store), `4` (office), `5` (factory), `6` (hotel), `7` (restaurant), `8` (other), `9` (empty site type), `10` (community), `11` (school). |
| systemSceneCustom | No | String | Custom scene; required when `systemScene=8`. Up to 200 characters. |
| city | No | String | Site (system) city. 1 to 128 characters. Cannot contain special characters such as `: * ? " < > \|`. |
| street | No | String | Site (system) street. 0 to 128 characters. Cannot contain special characters such as `: * ? " < > \|`. |
| location | No | String | Site (system) detailed address. 0 to 128 characters. Cannot contain special characters such as `: * ? " < > \|`. |
| state | No | String | Site (system) state. 0 to 128 characters. Cannot contain special characters such as `: * ? " < > \|`. |
| description | No | String | Site (system) description. 0 to 500 characters. |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| errorCode | String | Required. Status or error code: `0`-success. |
| message | String | Optional. Status or error description, one-to-one with the code. |
| data | Object | Required. Response data object. |
| data.systemId | String | Required. Unique site (system) ID. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "location": "",
  "systemName": "New Site_20251120_204703",
  "timezone": 26,
  "syncTimezone": 1,
  "street": "",
  "city": "",
  "state": "",
  "systemScene": 9,
  "description": "",
  "serverType": [
    0,
    1
  ],
  "systemSceneCustom": ""
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0",
  "message": "",
  "data": {
    "systemId": "4b8c651224b84145a6dcb2f6c08da406"
  }
}
```

**Notes:**
- The returned `data.systemId` is the `{id}` used in `site/team/{id}/modify` and `site/team/{id}/delete`, and the `systemId` in `site/team/handover`.

### 4.2 Search Team Sites

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/team/search
```

Search team sites.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/team/search`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| page | No | Integer | Page No. If absent, the first page by default. |
| pageSize | No | Integer | Items per page. Default: 20. |
| systemName | No | String | Site (system) name. Fuzzy search supported. |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| errorCode | String | Required. Status or error code: `0`-success. |
| message | String | Optional. Status or error description. |
| data | Object | Data returned on success. |
| data.total | Integer | Total number of results. |
| data.page | Integer | Current page No. If empty, the first page by default. |
| data.pageSize | Integer | Records per page. |
| data.totalPages | Integer | Total number of pages (example returns `totalPage`; see Notes). |
| data.rows | Object[] | Site (system) information list. |
| data.rows[].systemId | String | Site (system) ID. |
| data.rows[].country | String | Site (system) country. |
| data.rows[].systemName | String | Site (system) name (PDF table: "Partition name"; see Notes). |
| data.rows[].city | String | Site (system) city. |
| data.rows[].timezone | number | Time zone. See A.3 Time Zone List. |
| data.rows[].street | String | Site (system) street. |
| data.rows[].location | String | Site (system) detailed address. 0 to 128 characters. |
| data.rows[].state | String | Site (system) state. 0 to 128 characters. |
| data.rows[].description | String | Site (system) description. |
| data.rows[].systemScene | Integer | Scene type. Values as in 4.1. |
| data.rows[].mode | Integer | Site handover mode: `0` (handover by transfer), `1` (handover by sharing). |
| data.rows[].syncTimezone | Integer | Time zone synchronization: `0` (no), `1` (yes). |
| data.rows[].systemManagerPermission | Boolean | Whether the service management permission is granted (allows activating, renewing and managing HCT services): `true` (granted), `false` (not granted). |
| data.rows[].remoteAccess | Boolean | Whether the system access permission is granted (allows remote access to the Hik-Connect for Teams system): `true` (granted), `false` (not granted). |
| data.rows[].serverType | Array | Activated services. Values as in 4.1. |
| data.rows[].inviteStatus | Integer | Site (system) status: `0` (created), `1` (invitation not confirmed), `2` (authorized), `4` (handed over, not authorized), `5` (dissolved), `7` (not registered). |
| data.rows[].ownerInfo | Object | Owner information. Only valid after the site has been handed over. |
| data.rows[].ownerInfo.siteOwnerName | String | Site owner name. |
| data.rows[].ownerInfo.siteOwnerMail | String | Site owner email. |
| data.rows[].ownerInfo.siteOwnerPhone | String | Site owner phone. |
| data.rows[].ownerInfo.siteAccount | String | Site owner account. |
| data.rows[].managerInfo[] | Object[] | Site manager information. |
| data.rows[].managerInfo[].id | String | Manager ID. |
| data.rows[].managerInfo[].firstName | String | Manager first name. |
| data.rows[].managerInfo[].lastName | String | Manager last name. |
| data.rows[].managerInfo[].phone | String | Manager phone. |
| data.rows[].managerInfo[].email | String | Manager email. |
| data.rows[].managerInfo[].siteAllPermission | Boolean | Whether the manager has the Manage All Sites permission. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "page": 1,
  "pageSize": 20,
  "systemName": ""
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "data": {
    "pageSize": 10,
    "rows": [
      {
        "systemId": "073f466df9f04c5eb28f1379cb97db62",
        "country": "",
        "systemName": "openAPI-Team11",
        "city": "",
        "timezone": 141,
        "street": "",
        "description": "12345676678901",
        "location": "",
        "state": "A",
        "systemScene": 8,
        "systemManagerPermission": true,
        "remoteAccess": true,
        "inviteStatus": 7,
        "mode": 0,
        "syncTimezone": 1,
        "managerInfo": [
          {
            "id": "feb99145fc554d97b66a8bb62bce0b91",
            "lastName": "470997",
            "phone": "",
            "email": "uat13-v3-20251126@example.net"
          }
        ],
        "ownerInfo": {
          "siteOwnerName": "test1",
          "siteOwnerMail": "test@example.com",
          "siteOwnerPhone": "",
          "siteAccount": "test@example.com"
        }
      },
      {
        "systemId": "35998569dfb7451bb05d03aa85fe1f10",
        "country": "",
        "systemName": "open-edit",
        "city": "",
        "timezone": 26,
        "street": "",
        "description": "",
        "location": "",
        "state": "",
        "systemScene": 0,
        "systemManagerPermission": true,
        "remoteAccess": true,
        "inviteStatus": 7,
        "mode": 0,
        "syncTimezone": 0,
        "managerInfo": [
          {
            "id": "feb99145fc554d97b66a8bb62bce0b91",
            "lastName": "470997",
            "phone": "",
            "email": "uat13-v3-20251126@example.com"
          }
        ],
        "ownerInfo": {
          "siteOwnerName": "",
          "siteOwnerMail": "",
          "siteOwnerPhone": "",
          "siteAccount": "1284-012345678901234567890123"
        }
      }
    ],
    "total": 12,
    "totalPage": 2,
    "page": 2
  },
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The PDF table names the page total `totalPages`, but the example returns `totalPage` (as in `site/search`). Verify the real name in your environment.
- The table declares `managerInfo` as Object, but the example returns an array; documented as `data.rows[].managerInfo[]`. The example omits `firstName` and `siteAllPermission`.
- The table describes `systemName` as "Partition name"; by context (and the example) it is the site (system) name.
- The table lists `systemId` twice inside `rows`; documented once here.
- The example rows omit `serverType`, although the table lists it.
- The PDF response table marks every `data` field as optional.

### 4.3 Edit Team Site

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/team/{id}/modify
```

Edit a team site.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/team/{id}/modify`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Path Parameters:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| id | Yes | String | Site (system) ID. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| systemName | Yes | String | Site (system) name. 1 to 128 characters. Cannot contain special characters such as `: * ? " < > \|`. |
| timezone | Yes | Integer | Time zone. See A.3 Time Zone List. |
| syncTimezone | Yes | Integer | Whether to synchronize the site time zone to the devices on the site: `1` (enable), `0` or other values (disable). If absent, disabled by default. |
| systemScene | No | Integer | Scene type. Values as in 4.1. |
| systemSceneCustom | No | String | Custom scene; required when `systemScene=8`. Up to 200 characters. |
| city | No | String | Site (system) city. 1 to 128 characters. Cannot contain special characters such as `: * ? " < > \|`. |
| street | No | String | Site (system) street. 0 to 128 characters. Cannot contain special characters such as `: * ? " < > \|`. |
| location | No | String | Site (system) detailed address. 0 to 128 characters. Cannot contain special characters such as `: * ? " < > \|`. |
| state | No | String | Site (system) state. 0 to 128 characters. Cannot contain special characters such as `: * ? " < > \|`. |
| description | No | String | Site (system) description. 0 to 500 characters. |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| errorCode | String | Required. Status or error code: `0`-success. |
| message | String | Optional. Status or error description. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "systemName": "New Site_20251126_6",
  "city": "dfddd",
  "street": "aaa",
  "description": "asdasdasd",
  "location": "sss",
  "state": "Singapore",
  "systemScene": 2,
  "systemSceneCustom": "",
  "timezone": 26,
  "syncTimezone": 1
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0",
  "message": "Ok"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Unlike `site/team/add`, `syncTimezone` is Required here, although the PDF keeps the text "if the field is absent, it is disabled by default".
- This API does not accept `serverType`.

### 4.4 Hand Over Team Site

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/team/handover
```

Hand over a team site to the customer. If `serverType` was not sent when the team site was created, no services are activated and devices cannot be added.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/team/handover`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| systemId | Yes | String | Tenant (site/system) ID. |
| systemName | Yes | String | Site (system) name. |
| handOverBy | Yes | Integer | Handover method: `1` (email), `2` (phone number). |
| contact | Yes | String | Email or phone number, according to `handOverBy`. Phone format: international area code-phone number. Max length: 64 for email, 24 for phone. |
| customerName | No | String | Customer name. 0 to 128 characters. Cannot contain special characters such as `: * ? " < > \|`. |
| remark | No | String | Remarks. 0 to 128 characters. Cannot contain special characters such as `: * ? " < > \|`. |
| language | Yes | String | Language abbreviation (email template language identifier). See A.2 Languages. |
| customerPhone | No | String | Customer phone. Valid when `handOverBy = 1` (email). Max length 24; digits only. |
| mode | Yes | Integer | Site handover mode: `0` (handover by transfer), `1` (handover by sharing). |
| allPermission | No | Boolean | Whether to grant all site permissions. Only valid when `mode = 1` (sharing). `false` or absent: not all permissions granted. `true`: all permissions granted, and both `permission` fields are mandatory. |
| permission | No | Object | If `allPermission` is `true` in sharing mode, all permissions are granted automatically. |
| permission.systemManager | No | Boolean | Whether to grant the system management permission (i.e. authorize the site). Default: `false`. If `false`, `remoteAccess` can only be `-1`. |
| permission.remoteAccess | No | Integer | Remote access permission, in hours. When `systemManager` is `true`, default `0`; when `false`, fixed at `-1` (no permission). Values: `-1` (no permission), `0` (permanent), `1` (1 h), `2` (2 h), `4` (4 h), `8` (8 h). Custom values must be multiples of 24 (e.g. `48` = 2 days). |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| errorCode | String | Required. Service status or error code: `0`-success. |
| message | String | Optional. Status or error description. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "systemId": "b7c90bdd946a4082972db40002f89327",
  "handOverBy": 1,
  "remark": "1123",
  "contact": "20241125@example.net",
  "customerName": "",
  "language": "en",
  "systemName": "New Site_20251124_151912",
  "customerPhone": "",
  "mode": 0,
  "allPermission": false,
  "permission": {
    "systemManager": false,
    "remoteAccess": -1
  }
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0",
  "message": "Ok"
}
```

**Notes:**
- `handOverBy` values (`1` email, `2` phone) do NOT match the `type` values of the sharing-handover APIs in chapter 3 (`0` email, `1` phone).
- The PDF puts the `serverType` warning in this API's description, although that field is set when creating the team site (`site/team/add`).

### 4.5 Delete Team Site

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/site/team/{id}/delete
```

Delete a team site.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/site/team/{id}/delete`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Path Parameters:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| id | Yes | String | Site (system) ID. Get it with the team site search API (`site/team/search`). |

**Request Body:** none.

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| errorCode | String | Required. Status or error code: `0`-success. |
| message | String | Required. Status or error description, one-to-one with the code. |

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0",
  "message": "Ok"
}
```

## 5. DEVICE MANAGEMENT

Sections 5.1–5.5 cover device information; 5.6–5.11 cover device operation.

### 5.1 Add Devices

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v2/device/add
```

Add device information to a site.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v2/device/add`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| deviceList | Yes | Array | Device list. Cannot be empty. |
| deviceList[].deviceSerial | Yes | String | Device serial No. Cannot be empty; 1 to 9 characters. |
| deviceList[].validateCode | Yes | String | Device verification code. Cannot be empty; 1 to 18 characters. |
| deviceList[].extendInfo | No | String | Extended information; custom information supported. 1 to 256 characters. |
| siteId | Yes | String | ID of the site the devices are added to. Cannot be empty; 1 to 48 characters. |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| data | Object | Response data. |
| data.addSuccessList | Object[] | Devices added successfully. Can be empty. |
| data.addSuccessList[].deviceCategory | String | Device type (see the `deviceCategory` table in 5.4). |
| data.addSuccessList[].deviceName | String | Device name. |
| data.addSuccessList[].deviceSerial | String | Device serial No. |
| data.addFailedList | Object[] | Devices that failed to be added. Can be empty. |
| data.addFailedList[].deviceSerial | String | Device serial No. |
| data.addFailedList[].failReason | String | Failure reason. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "deviceList": [
    {
      "deviceSerial": "abc",
      "validateCode": "def",
      "extendInfo": "xxx"
    }
  ],
  "siteId": "aaaaa"
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "data": {
    "addFailedList": [
      {
        "deviceSerial": "abc",
        "failReason": "add Exception{LAP006001}"
      },
      {
        "deviceSerial": "def",
        "failReason": "add Exception{LAP006001}"
      }
    ],
    "addSuccessList": [
      {
        "deviceCategory": "0",
        "deviceName": "string",
        "deviceSerial": "abc"
      }
    ]
  },
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- In the PDF table the field appears as `siteld` (capital `I` rendered as `l`); the example confirms the correct name is `siteId`.
- Here `deviceCategory` is returned as String (`"0"`), while `device/list` returns it as Integer.
- A response with `errorCode: "0"` can still include failed devices: always check `addFailedList`.

### 5.4 Get Device List

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/device/list
```

Get the device list.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/device/list`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| page | No | Integer | Page No. Default: page 1. |
| pageSize | No | Integer | Items per page. Default: 20. |
| siteId | No | String | Site ID. |
| deviceSerial | No | String | Device serial No. |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| data | Object | Response data (`page`, `pageSize`, `rows`, `total`, `totalPage`). |
| data.rows[].id | String | Device ID. |
| data.rows[].deviceName | String | Device name. |
| data.rows[].deviceOnlineStatus | Integer | Device status: `0` (offline), `1` (online), `2` (unknown). |
| data.rows[].deviceSerial | String | Device serial No. |
| data.rows[].deviceVersion | String | Device version No. |
| data.rows[].deviceType | String | Device model. |
| data.rows[].deviceCategory | Integer | Device category. See the `deviceCategory` table below. |
| data.rows[].deviceSubCategory | Integer | Device sub-category. See the `deviceSubCategory` table below. |
| data.rows[].isSubscribed | Boolean | Whether event information is subscribed. |
| data.rows[].deviceAddTime | String | Time the device was added (ISO 8601), e.g. `"2021-03-25T06:26:01.927Z"`. |
| data.rows[].timeZone | String | Time zone. See A.3 Time Zone List. |
| data.rows[].extInfo | String | Extended information added to the device. |
| data.rows[].siteID | String | Site ID. |
| data.rows[].siteName | String | Site name. |
| data.rows[].deviceShareFlag | Boolean | Whether it is a shared device. |
| data.rows[].arcId | String | ID of the linked ARC. |
| data.rows[].arcCompanyName | String | Name of the linked ARC company. |

**`deviceCategory` values:**
| Value | Category |
|-------|----------|
| `1` | IPC |
| `2` | NVR |
| `3` | AlarmHost |
| `4` | Intercom |
| `5` | AccessControl |
| `7` | IPDome |
| `8` | Doorbell |
| `9` | StorageBox |
| `10` | thermalCamera |
| `11` | Switch |
| `12` | Other (radar, network speaker) |
| `99` | All devices |

**`deviceSubCategory` values:**
| Value | Sub-category |
|-------|--------------|
| `0` | unknown |
| `1` | NVR |
| `2` | DVR |
| `3` | AX2 |
| `4` | AX Hub |
| `5` | AX Hybrid |
| `6` | panic alarm station |
| `7` | box panic alarm station |
| `8` | pole panic alarm station |
| `9` | MinMoe |
| `10` | AX Hybrid Pro |
| `11` | solar-powered camera |
| `12` | door station |
| `13` | fall detection radar |
| `14` | AxECO |
| `15` | SwitchNet |
| `16` | SwitchAC |
| `17` | SwitchAP |
| `18` | SIGN RADAR |
| `19` | IP SPEAKER |
| `20` | NVS |
| `21` | SwitchRouter |
| `23` | Interactive Screen |
| `24` | Information Publish |
| `25` | LEDDeviceCard |
| `26` | NetworkAmplifier |
| `27` | Bridge |
| `28` | IndoorUnit |

- IP Speaker (audio APIs, section 10) = `deviceCategory` `12` + `deviceSubCategory` `19`.
- Solar camera (5.11 wake-up) = `deviceSubCategory` `11`.

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "page": 1,
  "pageSize": 20
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "data": {
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "rows": [
      {
        "deviceCategory": 3,
        "deviceName": "xxx",
        "deviceOnlineStatus": 0,
        "deviceSerial": " Q01728482",
        "deviceVersion": " V2.0.0 build 200224",
        "id": "xxxxxxxxxx",
        "deviceSubCategory": 0,
        "deviceType": "DS-PWA96-M-WE",
        "isSubscribed": 1,
        "deviceAddTime": "2014-03-25T06:26:01.927Z",
        "timeZone": "182",
        "extInfo": "xxxx",
        "siteID": "xxxxxxxx",
        "siteName": "xxx",
        "deviceShareFlag": false,
        "arcId": "xxx",
        "arcCompanyName": "xxx"
      }
    ],
    "total": 0,
    "totalPage": 0
  },
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The PDF response table lists the device fields flat; the example nests them in `data.rows[]` together with `page`, `pageSize`, `total` and `totalPage`. The example structure is documented here.
- The PDF does not define `deviceCategory` `6` or `deviceSubCategory` `22`; the lists above reproduce the PDF exactly.
- In the request table the field appears as `siteld` (typography); the correct name is `siteId`. In the response the field is `siteID` (capital `D`).
- `isSubscribed` is declared Boolean, but the example shows `1`. Accept both when parsing.
- In the PDF example, `deviceAddTime` uses typographic quotes (`”…”`), making it invalid JSON; fixed here to straight quotes.
- The leading spaces in `deviceSerial` (`" Q01728482"`) and `deviceVersion` (`" V2.0.0 build 200224"`) are as in the PDF example.

### 5.5 Get Device Channel List

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/device/camera/list
```

Get the list of channels linked to a device.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/device/camera/list`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| deviceSerial | Yes | String | Device serial No. |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| data | Object[] | Channel list. |
| data[].deviceSerial | String | Device serial No. |
| data[].ipcSerial | String | Network camera serial No. |
| data[].channelNo | int | Channel No. |
| data[].deviceName | String | Device name. |
| data[].channelName | String | Channel name. |
| data[].status | int | Channel status: `0` (offline), `1` (online), `-1` (unknown). |
| data[].isShared | String | Channel sharing status: `0` (not shared), `1` (shared with others), `2` (shared by others). |
| data[].isEncrypt | int | Whether the stream is encrypted: `0` (no), `1` (yes). |
| data[].videoLevel | int | Video resolution: `0` (fluent), `1` (balanced), `2` (HD), `3` (ultra HD). |
| data[].relatedIpc | boolean | Whether the current channel is linked to the network camera: `true` (yes), `false` (no). |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "deviceSerial": "abc"
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "deviceSerial": "427734222",
      "ipcSerial": "427734222",
      "channelNo": 1,
      "deviceName": "My(427734222)427734222",
      "channelName": "My(427734222)427734222",
      "status": 1,
      "isShared": "0",
      "isEncrypt": 0,
      "videoLevel": 2,
      "relatedIpc": false
    }
  ],
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The PDF response table lists the fields flat; the example shows `data` is an array of channels. The example structure is documented here.
- `isShared` is a String (`"0"`), unlike the other (numeric) status fields.

### 5.6 Enable or Disable End User Operation Permission

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/device/cloud/enable
```

Enable or disable the end users' device operation permission. After the site has been handed over to the end user by sharing, you can disable Hik-Connect Mobile Client for the devices; once disabled, the end user cannot operate the devices (live view, playback, arming/disarming, etc.) in Hik-Connect Mobile Client.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/device/cloud/enable`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| siteId | Yes | String | Site ID. |
| cloudEnable | Yes | Boolean | Enable or disable the device permission: `true` (enable), `false` (disable). |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "siteId": "abcdcedfhg",
  "cloudEnable": false
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Although the path is under `device/`, the permission is applied at site level (`siteId`). The `cloudEnable` field of 2.4 Search Sites reflects the result.

**Response:**

### 5.8 Upgrade Device Firmware

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/device/upgrade
```

Upgrade the device firmware. For first-generation security panels (AlarmHost, `deviceCategory` `3`), `username` and `password` are mandatory. For other security panels, `pinCode` is mandatory and `username` is optional.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/device/upgrade`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| deviceSerial | Yes | String | Device serial No. |
| password | No | String | Password of the EN-certified device. |
| username | No | String | User name of the EN-certified device. |
| pinCode | No | String | PIN code, obtained with 5.7 Query Device PIN Code. |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| data | Object | Response data. |
| data.deviceSerial | String | Device serial No. |
| data.error | String | Error code when upgrading failed. |
| data.errorDesc | String | Error description when upgrading failed. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "deviceSerial": "abc",
  "password": "xxx",
  "username": "xxx",
  "pinCdode": "xxx"
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "data": {
    "deviceSerial": "xxxx",
    "error": "xxxx",
    "errorDesc": "xxxx"
  },
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The PDF request example spells the key `pinCdode`, but the table defines `pinCode`. The example is kept as in the PDF; send `pinCode` per the table and verify in your environment.
- The table marks `username`, `password` and `pinCode` as optional, but whether they are mandatory depends on the panel type (see the description above).
- In the PDF the `pinCode` description refers to "Request Parameters"; by context it means the `device/pincode/query` API.

### 5.9 Get Device Upgrade Progress

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/device/upgrade/progress
```

Get the firmware upgrade progress of a device.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/device/upgrade/progress`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| deviceSerial | Yes | String | Device serial No. |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| data | Object | Response data. |
| data.deviceSerial | String | Device serial No. |
| data.progress | Integer | Upgrading progress (%). |
| data.statue | Integer | `0`-to be upgraded, `1`-start upgrading, `2`-download in progress, `3`-download finished, `4`-burning in progress, `5`-burning finished, `6`-rebooting, `7`-upgrade finished, `8`-device returns error code. |
| data.error | String | Error code when upgrading failed. |
| data.errorDesc | String | Error description when upgrading failed. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "deviceSerial": "abc"
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "data": {
    "progress": 1,
    "statue": 1,
    "error": "xxxx",
    "errorDesc": "xxxx"
  },
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The status field is literally `statue` (not `status`) in both table and example; keep it as is.
- The table includes `deviceSerial` in the response, but the PDF example omits it.

## 6. ARC SERVICE

The PDF groups these 6 endpoints under one subsection, "ARC Resources". For ARC (Alarm Receiving
Center) integration, call the OpenAPIs with the ARC ID / ARC Key requested in the Hik-Partner Pro
portal; they are equivalent to the API Key / API Secret and are sent as `appKey` / `secretKey` in
1.1 Get Token. `arcservice/device/list` and `arcservice/site/{id}/info` are available to ARC users
only; the other four are available to both ARC users and installers.

### 6.1 Get ARC-Enabled Devices

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/arcservice/device/list
```

Get the list of devices with ARC service enabled. Available to ARC users only.
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/arcservice/device/list`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| page | No | Integer | Page No. The value is page 1. |
| pageSize | No | Integer | Items per page. Default: 20. |
| siteId | No | Integer | Site ID. |
| deviceSerialList | No | String[] | Set of device serial No.s. Up to 200 items. |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| data | Object | Response data (`page`, `pageSize`, `rows`, `total`, `totalPage`). |
| data.rows[].id | String | Device ID. |
| data.rows[].deviceName | String | Device name. |
| data.rows[].deviceOnlineStatus | Integer | Device status: `0` (offline), `1` (online), `2` (unknown). |
| data.rows[].deviceSerial | String | Device serial No. |
| data.rows[].deviceVersion | String | Device version No. |
| data.rows[].deviceType | String | Device model. |
| data.rows[].deviceCategory | Integer | Device category: `1` (IPC), `2` (NVR), `3` (AlarmHost), `4` (Intercom), `5` (AccessControl), `7` (IPDome), `8` (Doorbell), `9` (StorageBox), `10` (thermalCamera), `11` (Switch), `99` (all devices). |
| data.rows[].deviceSubCategory | Integer | Device sub-category: `0` (unknown), `1` (NVR), `2` (DVR), `3` (AX2), `4` (AX Hub), `5` (AX Hybrid), `6` (panic alarm station), `7` (box panic alarm station), `8` (pole panic alarm station), `9` (MinMoe), `10` (AX Hybrid Pro), `11` (solar-powered camera), `12` (door station), `13` (fall detection radar). |
| data.rows[].isSubscribed | Boolean | Whether event/alarm information is subscribed. |
| data.rows[].deviceAddTime | String | Time the device was added (ISO 8601), e.g. `"2021-03-25T06:26:01.927Z"`. |
| data.rows[].timeZone | String | Time zone. See A.3 Time Zone List. |
| data.rows[].extInfo | String | Extended information added to the device. |
| data.rows[].siteID | String | Site ID. |
| data.rows[].siteName | String | Site name. |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "page": 1,
  "pageSize": 20,
  "deviceSerialList": ["xxxx", "xxxx"]
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "data": {
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "rows": [
      {
        "deviceCategory": 3,
        "deviceName": "xxx",
        "deviceOnlineStatus": 0,
        "deviceSerial": " Q01728482",
        "deviceVersion": " V2.0.0 build 200224",
        "id": "xxxxxxxxxx",
        "deviceSubCategory": 0,
        "deviceType": "DS-PWA96-M-WE",
        "isSubscribed": 1,
        "deviceAddTime": "2014-03-25T06:26:01.927Z",
        "timeZone": "182",
        "extInfo": "xxxx",
        "siteID": "xxxxxxxx",
        "siteName": "xxx"
      }
    ],
    "total": 0,
    "totalPage": 0
  },
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The PDF response table lists the device fields flat, but the example nests them in `data.rows[]` with `page`, `pageSize`, `total` and `totalPage`. The example structure is documented here.
- In the request the site ID is `siteId` (Integer); in the response it is `siteID` (String). Respect each spelling.
- The `deviceCategory` / `deviceSubCategory` lists here are shorter than those of 5.4 (no `12`, sub-categories only up to `13`); they reproduce this table of the PDF.
- `isSubscribed` is declared Boolean, but the example returns `1`. Accept both.
- In the PDF example `deviceAddTime` uses typographic quotes (`”…”`), making it invalid JSON; shown with straight quotes. The leading spaces in `deviceSerial` and `deviceVersion` are as in the PDF.

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |

### 6.4 Edit Device ARC Event Types

```
POST /api/hpcgw/v1/arcservice/event/type/update
```

Edit the ARC event list of a device. Available to ARC users and installers. Either `ax2PermissionList` or `CCTVEventList` must be configured: `ax2PermissionList` holds the specific permissions for AX PRO series devices; `CCTVEventList` is the event list of encoding devices (cameras/recorders).
**Request URL:** `https://{areaDomain}/api/hpcgw/v1/arcservice/event/type/update`

**Headers:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Content type: `application/json`. |
| Authorization | Yes | String | Authentication information, in the format `Bearer <accessToken>`. |

**Request Body:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| deviceSerial | Yes | String | Device serial No. |
| ax2PermissionList | No | List<Integer> | Events supported by the security control panel. Each edit fully overwrites the previous list (e.g. set `<10, 11, 12, 13>` then `<10>` → `<10>` applies). **AX PRO and AX Hybrid Pro series:** `10`-PIRCAM Gif, `11`-Video Clips, `12`-Panic Alarm, `13`-Medical Alarm, `14`-Fire Alarm, `15`-Smart Alarm, `16`-Panel Lid Opened, `17`-Peripheral Tamper, `18`-Zone Alarm, `19`-System Operation, `21`-Panel Status (Power&Battery), `22`-Panel Status (Communications), `23`-Zone Status, `24`-Peripherals Status, `45`-Panel Upgrade. **AX Home series:** `5`-Alarms, `6`-Faults, `7`-Operations, `8`-System Events. |
| CCTVEventList | No | List<Integer> | Supported events (encoding devices). Each edit fully overwrites the previous list (e.g. `<1, 2, 3>` then `<4>` → `<4>` applies); `<0>` cancels all previously configured values. `1`-IO, `2`-VMD, `3`-diskerror, `4`-diskfull, `5`-diskrecover, `6`-fielddetection, `7`-linedetection, `9`-recordException, `10`-regionEntrance, `11`-regionExiting, `12`-shelteralarm, `13`-videoloss, `14`-fireDetection, `15`-TMPA, `16`-TMA, `17`-TDA. |

For the AX PRO series, third-level permissions must be sent together with their second-level permission: `10`–`18` belong to `39`; `21`–`24` to `40`; `19` to `41`; `45` to `42`.

**ARC permissions (PDF Figure 3-1):**
| 1st-level | 2nd-level | 2nd-level value | 3rd-level permissions (value) |
|-----------|-----------|-----------------|-------------------------------|
| ARC | Alarms | `39` | Zone Alarm `18` · Peripheral Tamper `17` · Panel Lid Opened `16` · Keypad/keyfob/APP Panic Alarm `12` · Keypad/keyfob Medical Alarm `13` · Keypad Fire Alarm `14` · Camera Events `15` · PIRCAM Gif `10` · Video Clips `11` |
| ARC | Faults | `40` | Panel Status (Power and Battery) `21` · Panel Status (Communications) `22` · Zone Status `23` · Peripherals Status `24` |
| ARC | Operations | `41` | System Operations `19` |
| ARC | System Events | `42` | Panel Upgrade `45` |

**Response:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| data.permission | Integer | ARC permission status: `0` (request in progress), `1` (editing applied), `null` (editing failed). |

**Request Example:**

```json
{
  "deviceSerial": "xxx",
  "ax2PermissionLists": [
    22
  ],
  "eventFilterLists": [
    1
  ]
}
```

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "data": {
    "permission": 1
  },
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Notes:**
- The PDF table names the fields `ax2PermissionList` and `CCTVEventList`, but the request example uses `ax2PermissionLists` and `eventFilterLists`. The example is kept as in the PDF; verify which names the API accepts before fixing your integration.
- The PDF table describes `CCTVEventList` with the same text as `ax2PermissionList` ("supported by the security control panel"), although the API description says it is the encoding-device event list; the latter is used here.
- In the ARC permissions figure `15` is "Camera Events", while in the AX PRO list it is "Smart Alarm". Both are documented as in the PDF.

| …shareToCompany/shareFromCompany.firstName | String | Person's first name. |

**Response Example (site shared with others):**

```json
    "siteName": "",
    "siteCity": "",
    "siteState": "",
    "siteStreet": "",
    "location": "",

    "timeZone": "",

    "installerFirstName": "",
    "installerLastName": "",
    "installerEmail": "",
    "installerPhone": "",

    "siteOwnerPhone": "",

      "shareState": 4,
      "shareType": 3,
      "shareToCompany": {
        "address": "",
        "companyName": "",
        "email": "",
        "firstName": "",
        "lastName": "",
        "phone": "",
        "street": ""
      }
    }
  },
  "errorCode": "0"
}
```

**Response Example (site shared by others):**

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "",
    "installerFirstName": "",
    "installerId": "",
    "installerLastName": "",
    "location": "",
    "siteCity": "",
    "siteName": "",
    "siteState": "",
    "siteStreet": "",

      "shareState": 4,
      "shareType": 4,

        "address": "",
        "companyName": "",
```
